fixes_since_v3.root_cause: Real Windows host run of llama-research-v3 (b_selected, decay=0.99, interval=64) completed 512 tokens of real inference with the retention-policy startup line printed and ARGINE_RETENTION_TRACE opened successfully, but the trace file remained 0 bytes. Root cause: psx_cache_attach_retention_policy()/servi_evento_con_politica() (the sole location of both the retention-policy decision dispatch for the cache and the trace writer) is reached ONLY via psx_cache_ensure_many(), which is called ONLY when ARGINE_EXPERT_READ=blocco. The host run left ARGINE_EXPERT_READ unset, so the default LETTURA_ASINCRONA read mode (psx_cache_avvia/psx_cache_attendi) served every real expert read instead -- a path with zero awareness of the retention policy. The policy object was created and the startup line printed correctly, but it was never actually consulted for any real eviction/admission decision during that run. Confirmed both by static code-path analysis and against the real host log (diagnostic-b_selected-v3.out.log: 'lettura asincrono' printed immediately after 'retention policy attiva'). The trace-writer code itself was already correct (per-event conditioning, correct before/after causality, already called fflush()) -- the bug was that its only call site was never reached.
fixes_since_v3.fix: Contesto::inizializza() now aborts at startup (GGML_ABORT) if a retention policy is requested while the read mode is not LETTURA_BLOCCO, using the same fail-closed template already in place for ARGINE_EXPERT_SHARDS=1 a few lines above it. ARGINE_EXPERT_READ=blocco is now a hard requirement for using ARGINE_RETENTION_POLICY on this runtime.
fixes_since_v3.diagnostics_added: Five new counters on psx_retention_stats (trace_requested, trace_opened, trace_rows_attempted, trace_rows_written, trace_write_failed), readable via psx_cache_get_retention_stats(); an stderr line printed at successful trace-open time; an unconditional (not -v-gated) summary line printed in Contesto's destructor whenever a retention policy was active, reporting all four counters with an explicit warning if events were observed but zero rows were written.
fixes_since_v3.test_coverage: patches/argine-retention-integration-test.cpp sections 7-10 (37 checks total, all passing against the real Qwen_Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M.psxs store), exercising the same psx_cache_ensure_many() entry point used by real inference: (7) a trace-enabled event produces a non-empty JSONL row with real policy fields -- the exact symptom reproduced and fixed; (8) multiple events produce multiple distinct rows; (9) no ARGINE_RETENTION_TRACE set produces no file, policy still served; (10) a forced write failure (ARGINE_RETENTION_TRACE=/dev/full) is surfaced via trace_write_failed rather than silently swallowed.
fixes_since_v3.known_test_gap: The new ARGINE_EXPERT_READ fail-closed guard lives in Contesto::inizializza(), which requires a full ggml/llama.cpp context to instantiate and is not reachable from the psx_cache-level integration-test harness (same limitation as the pre-existing ARGINE_EXPERT_SHARDS=1 guard a few lines above it, which also has no dedicated unit test). Its real coverage is this runtime rebuild and the next host run's startup behavior.
